vb_textbox.text: The rule of the game seems to be choosing a gnome based on hat size, but will switch throughout the game. so for me it started with picking the gnome with the big hat resulted in getting more mushrooms. This didn't last long until it switched to the small hat giving more mushrooms. Choosing the smaller hat went on for longer than the big hat. towards the last 3rd of the game it seemed to try and trick me into thinking it was switching from one size to the other and although it would do sometimes it also wouldn't some of the time (I hope that makes sense).
